slice: part 2: the shark in the migration client, the controller's wiring, a seed for each dive, and legacy's sprite
command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run license-check && npm run sites:check && npm run devcontainer:check && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run pixi:visual-check && npm run interior:check && npx playwright test
workingTree: clean before and after the run (git status --porcelain empty)
timestampProvenance: Both are date -u output printed around the run. The whole chain ran under the shared e2e port lock, taken before START and released after END.
provenanceNote: Branched from main 8b8c0bb (#222, legacy's bow opening and a solid engine block). The full run above is on d9228b4, the fix for pre-review pass 1 on PR #247: a dive resumed from a legacy save draws its own seed, once. Earlier full runs on d4a9780 (unit 589, parity 336, e2e 182) and 07592fa (unit 589, parity 341, e2e 182) also passed. The counter-checks M1 to M16 were taken on d4a9780, P1 to P3 on 07592fa and S1 to S3 on d9228b4. Between them only src/save, src/app/wreck-app.ts and the tests changed, and nothing those mutations touch. Later commits only update this file, so src, tests, scripts and docs are identical to the measured tree (see durableProvenance).

results.unit: 591 passed (+22: tests/unit/game-controller-shark.test.ts 5, src/render/camera.test.ts 7, tests/unit/dive-seed.test.ts 3, tests/unit/shark-encounter.test.ts 2, tests/unit/wreck-route.test.ts 2, tests/unit/save-repository.test.ts 2, tests/unit/site-layers.test.ts 1)
results.parity: 341 passed (+5 in tests/parity/shark-encounter.test.ts). The new tests: every recorded checkpoint a shark swims at, named, all four in shark-encounter-5m on the reef; the camera's 8 m lead against numbers written in the test; the named checkpoints on the camera's mid-route view, with legacy's values except the departing ones at spawned, second-spawn, contact-survived, gone and shark-attack; the route's floors against written numbers and legacy's 66 m floorAt, and where the depth departs; no recorded checkpoint reached by the route's floors. The replay of shark-encounter-5m on legacy's centred 1000 px view is unchanged.
results.e2e: 183 passed in 8.2 min, no retries, no flake (+5 in tests/shark.spec.js: the seed drawn at a dive's start is in its save; a dive resumed from a legacy save is seeded from the page's draw and its migrated save keeps it; a resumed shark 3 m behind attacks on a roll under 0.33 and passes, faster, on one above; two resumed dives on frames stepped by hand render the same frame, and with a shark in view a different one)
results.pixiVisualCheck: 3 scenes ok, 0% changed pixels, max delta 0, nothing re-recorded

rule: Owner decision on #219 (2026-10-07): each dive draws its own seed at its start and keeps it in randomState, so a resumed dive stays deterministic; the shark's spawn and exit distances follow the wreck camera's lead, so it appears just outside the visible edge. The second is recorded in docs/decisions.md as a departure from legacy's centred view. Beside it is the shark's floor guard on the route's floors, where legacy's reads the wreck's 66 m seabed (owner, 2026-10-10). Both rows name the checkpoints tests/parity/shark-encounter.test.ts asserts.
change: src/app/dive-seed.ts draws the seed from crypto.getRandomValues, and createWreckInitialState() starts each dive on it. src/app/game-controller.ts hands advanceWithBuoyancy() a DiveEnvironment.shark every frame: the clock's rate with fast-forward, the diver's swim along the route per dive second, the view to either side from wreckViewAround() (src/render/camera.ts: the 8 m lead and the camera's bound), the floor from floorUnder() (src/sites/wreck-route.ts) at the shark's position and depth, and the wreck's noShark. SharkFrame's viewHalfWidthM becomes viewLeftM and viewRightM, and its floorM a floorAt(offsetM, depthM) read after the swim. src/render/pixi-renderer.ts draws legacy's shark (src/renderer.js 1069-1124) once in the fauna layer and moves it each frame while DiveState.shark.encounter exists. The migration e2e specs (tests/helpers/pinned-seed.cjs) and scripts/pixi-visual-check.mjs pin the page's 32-bit draws to the seed the client used before, 0x57524543, so no run meets a shark by chance. A dive migrated from a legacy save (src/save/save-game.ts migrateLegacyV2) draws its seed once, from the legacySeed source LocalSaveRepository takes and wreck-app passes as drawDiveSeed; the migrated save written back keeps it, so a later resume goes on the same stream, and a current save is never re-seeded. Without a source the state stays 0, for tests.

counterChecks.method: Each mutation applied by a script to a file backed up beforehand, the named tests run (for e2e, after rebuilding the client) under the port lock with --retries=0, on the code of d4a9780 (M1 to M16) of 07592fa (P1 to P3, tests/parity/shark-encounter.test.ts; src is the same tree) and of d9228b4 (S1 to S3, the legacy import's seed). The first S3 mutation did not typecheck, so its build failed and the e2e ran on the previous build; the result below is from the typechecking form [drawDiveSeed][1]. Each file was then restored from its backup and compared with filecmp (shallow=False): byte for byte identical in every case. The first versions of the M7 and M8 mutations did not typecheck, so their builds failed before any e2e ran; the e2e results below are from the typechecking forms, void this.#sharkFrame(...) and drawDiveSeed() * 0 + 0x57524543.
